text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with less than half a month 
remaining until the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Timer
text_block_list.text: ...Beep! Pip, pip, pip, pip...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...! Haaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Phalaeno-kun! Keep it up. 
Don't let your pace drop too much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Currently, to build the stamina needed for 
the Oaks, 
she was taking on a regimen of interval 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A full-tilt surge while the tone is 
sounding, 
and light jogging when it stops... 
A routine designed to build stamina 
through repetition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. As you've witnessed, this 
training places a high-intensity load on 
the body.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As a result, it enhances cardiopulmonary 
function... 
allowing one to elevate their VO2 max.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... Did you also use this 
to build your stamina?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. 
Especially during the summer before the 
Kikuka Sho. 
When I truly needed to push myself, I even 
ran it on the uphill slopes.
choice_data_list: Y-You did this on the uphill slopes...!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Even I was utterly exhausted in 
both mind 
and body back then. I grew to thoroughly 
despise 
the sound used for the training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I could hear it continuously even in my 
sleep. 
That constant 'Beep! Pip, pip, pip, pip.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I imagine Phalaeno-kun is about 
ready 
to despise this sound as well—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... 
Phew... Not yet?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come... Come. —Sound.

text_block_list.name: Timer
text_block_list.text: ...Beep! Pip, pip, pip, pip...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph— 
Haaaaaaahhhhhhhaaaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Good grief... I am truly in awe 
of Phalaeno-kun's mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I knew she possessed great 
perseverance. 
Yet to have honed it even further—to this 
extent...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was fortunate enough 
to find a truly wonderful Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold my tongue before deflecting with 
modesty. If I want 
to be a Trainer worthy of her...
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'm doing everything I can to 
support her.

Right. I'm doing everything I can to 
support her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now then, 
I suppose it is time for me to pace 
alongside her.
choice_data_list:
(...I'm so glad I asked Hayahide for 
help.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More than just a pacing partner, she 
offered 
suggestions for new drills, pacing 
strategies 
for enduring long-distance races, and 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She poured all the knowledge she had 
accumulated 
into Phalaenopsis without holding anything 
back.
choice_data_list: If we keep training like this, surely—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide. You have my gratitude for your 
assistance today. 
Tomorrow as well, I look forward to—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...? What is the matter, Phalaeno-kun? 
Your footing seems unsteady.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, think nothing of it. 
My tension merely slipped once our 
training concluded.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Indeed, your complexion 
does not appear poor, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, let me give you a light 
massage. 
Would you mind coming to my room?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And next, your calves... —Hm. 
That should do it. How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, my legs feel far lighter than 
before. 
Did you possess knowledge of acupressure?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Far from it. I simply applied the 
self-care techniques 
I practice on a routine basis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I merely wished to be of some help to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......There is one thing that has weighed 
on my mind. 
Why do you look after me to such an 
extent?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought this kindness stemmed 
solely from being family. 
And surely, there was truth to that. But—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"Haa, haa... Ngh. Still, my pace... 
...Is it still too fast to save my 
legs...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to rush. We simply 
repeat it 
until your body learns the rhythm. Come, 
one more!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—You poured your very soul into helping 
me. 
Mere words of gratitude are no longer 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I wish to repay your kindness. Yet after 
having you give 
so much to me, what could I possibly offer 
in return that would suffice?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... You remain as dutiful as ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to take you up on that 
offer. 
What I ask of you is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: To produce results in the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is all. 
That alone... and yet, that is everything.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You know this as well, don't you, 
Phalaeno? 
There was a time when I, too, could not 
run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I suffered a severe injury in my youth. 
Fortunately, I was told 
a return was possible. But even so—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The frustration, the fear, the 
helplessness while pinned to that bed. 
I can still remember it even now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... I want to support 
you. You, who traversed a similar 
period of being unable to run, only to 
make it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No, forgive me. 
Merely saying "I want to support you" 
isn't quite right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I am placing my expectations 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Expectations...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That even from circumstances where running 
seems impossible, 
if she is armed with theory and 
knowledge—an Umamusume can run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And not merely run— 
She can even claim the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The spring of my Classic year. Both the 
Satsuki Sho 
and the Japanese Derby brought bitter 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...My hands could not reach the Triple 
Crown. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —If it is you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am projecting those feelings of mine 
onto you. 
...So in the end, it is purely for my own 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will be looking forward... to the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Haha. 
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that is it. 
You are placing your expectations upon me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then I must answer them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so arrived the day of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis is deep in concentration. 
At this rate—
choice_data_list:
(She's bound to show the fruits of our 
special training.)

(She should be able to show the fruits of 
our special training.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Is it time? 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Send me off.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I run to repay my debt of gratitude to 
the club. 
To repay my Trainer's devotion.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Yet—now there is another. 
Another hope placed upon my shoulders that 
I wish to fulfill.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even if my heart should burst, I shall 
answer it. 
These legs will not stop until I blow past 
the goal post.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will show you what it truly means to 
give everything.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I let what was in my heart slip 
out 
before I knew it, but... I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You would shoulder that much for me, would 
you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You truly haven't changed since we were 
young. 
You are so earnest... that it makes me 
want to entrust it to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Show me, Phalaeno. 
Show me what lies beyond that "game of 
tag."
